headline: AVG Logistics Limited: Monitoring Agency Report for Rights Issue (Q2 FY2026-27)
sum: AVG Logistics Limited filed a Monitoring Agency Report with NSE for a rights issue, detailing capital-raising activity for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 under ICDR/listing regulations.
implication: Rights issues trigger mandatory Monitoring Agency oversight under SEBI ICDR rules; the filing signals formal regulatory compliance for listed equity offerings and carries precedent for disclosure timing and Q-end subscription monitoring.
detail: The document is a Monitoring Agency Report filed by AVG Logistics Limited with the National Stock Exchange (NSE) for a rights issue covering the quarter ended 30 June 2026. Monitoring Agencies are appointed under SEBI's ICDR Regulations to oversee capital-raising activities and ensure compliance with disclosure and subscription norms. The filing is dated 14 August 2026 and indicates the company's adherence to post-issuance reporting requirements for listed equity offerings.
